svg.title: Troubleshooting
svg.desc: Symptom: The client lists no tools, Check: Run the command from the config by hand: …/umbra mcp should wait silently on stdin. Check the path is absolute.; Symptom: Every page shows a sign-in screen, Check: The server is on another profile than the one you signed in. Compare UMBRA_PROFILE in the config with your umbra sign-in run.; Symptom: Calls hang or fail after a crash, Check: umbra status shows the daemon. umbra stop (with the same profile) resets it; the next call starts a new one. Its log is ~/Library/Application Support/Umbra/daemon.log (daemon-<profile>.log for a profile).; Symptom: A call times out, Check: Inspect actual state before repeating an action. Use tasks/cancel with its request and owner, or wait for a specific condition.
